run_build_wasi_sdk: run the build_wasi_sdk.py script to download, build, and install the WASI SDK toolchain
download_repo: download and extract an external repository like llvm-project or wasi-libc to the WAMR deps directory
checksum_verify: verify the SHA256 checksum of a downloaded tarball against the expected hash in external_repos config
unpack_tarball: unpack a tar.gz file to a destination directory while stripping the top-level prefix folder
run_patch: apply a patch file to a target directory with a dry-run check before the actual patch
